# Micro-benchmark cases that the analysis is known to fail:
# `<case id>: <stream/group>: <reason>`. Generated by tests/triage.py, which
# holds the reasons; do not edit by hand. The marks are strict: when a case
# starts to pass, the suite fails until its line is removed.

assignments/global_rebind: flow/rebinding: a rebinding through `global` before the call keeps the old value
assignments/nonlocal_rebind: flow/rebinding: a rebinding through `nonlocal` before the call keeps the old value
async/call_soon_callback: outside/library-types: the result of asyncio.get_running_loop() is not an asyncio.EventLoop, and the loop callback belongs to the scope that runs the loop
async/coroutine_not_awaited: flow/uncalled: a coroutine that is never awaited still runs its body
async/explicit_event_loop: outside/library-types: the result of asyncio.new_event_loop() is not an asyncio.EventLoop
builtins/functools_partial: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: calling a functools.partial calls its function
builtins/functools_reduce: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: functools.reduce calls its function
builtins/itertools_callbacks: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: itertools calls the functions it gets
builtins/map_not_consumed: flow/uncalled: map() is lazy; its function is called back although the result is never consumed
classes/del_on_last_reference: dynamic/finalization: __del__ runs when the last reference goes, which the analysis does not know
classes/instance_attribute_shadows_method: dynamic/context: an instance attribute shadows the method for that instance only; fields and class attributes are merged
classes/per_instance_attributes: dynamic/context: two instances of one class that store different functions in one attribute
classes/type_of_instance_call: outside/builtin-models: type(obj) is not the class of obj: without calling context, the rule that makes it one grows the hub of hypothesis's drawn values until memory ends (design, Open problems)
closures/cell_rebound_after_definition: flow/closure-time: a captured variable rebound after the nested function is defined keeps both values
closures/early_binding_default: dynamic/context: a default bound per lambda in a loop: the lambda keeps every value
closures/factory_choice: flow/uncalled: the nested function that the factory does not return is still analysed as called
closures/late_binding_loop: flow/closure-time: lambdas created in a loop see the last value of the loop variable
closures/nonlocal_state: flow/closure-time: a closure that replaces a stored function: the old one stays
closures/separate_instances: dynamic/context: two closures from one factory share the captured variable
comprehensions/dict_comprehension_lookup: flow/container-update: a dict comprehension merges its entries under one unknown key
comprehensions/filtered_functions: flow/dead-code: the condition of a comprehension does not filter its elements
comprehensions/generator_short_circuit: flow/dead-code: any() stops at the first true value; every element is evaluated
comprehensions/lambda_late_binding: flow/closure-time: lambdas in a comprehension see the last value of its variable
comprehensions/walrus: flow/rebinding: an assignment expression keeps every value it took
context_managers/closing: outside/library-types: the __enter__ of contextlib.closing returns the class's type variable, which a typed value does not keep; and its __exit__ calling close is a standard-library call back
context_managers/context_decorator: outside/library-callables: a ContextDecorator used as a decorator: its wrapper and the __enter__ and __exit__ it calls
context_managers/contextmanager_handles_exception: flow/exceptions: the exception path is not followed: the call after the one that raises inside the with block is taken to run
context_managers/exit_stack_callbacks: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: ExitStack calls __enter__, __exit__ and the callbacks it gets
context_managers/exit_suppresses: flow/exceptions: __exit__ that returns True suppresses the exception; the code after the raise still counts
control_flow/assert_message_not_evaluated: flow/dead-code: the message of an assert that holds is evaluated
control_flow/continue_skips: flow/dead-code: `continue` does not skip the rest of the loop body
control_flow/early_return: flow/dead-code: calls after a return count
control_flow/generator_body_not_run: flow/uncalled: the body of a generator that is never iterated counts
control_flow/lazy_generator_expression: flow/uncalled: the element of a generator expression that is never consumed counts
control_flow/loop_rebinds_callee: flow/rebinding: the value bound after the last call in a loop is kept
control_flow/loop_variable_after_loop: flow/rebinding: the loop variable after the loop keeps every value
control_flow/main_guard: flow/uncalled: a function called only under a `__main__` guard that does not run keeps the calls of its body
control_flow/short_circuit: flow/dead-code: the right operand of `and` and `or` always counts
control_flow/try_except_path: flow/dead-code: the rest of a try block after a raise, and its else block, count
control_flow/try_no_exception: flow/dead-code: an except block that does not run counts
control_flow/while_break_else: flow/dead-code: calls after `break` and in the skipped else block count
decorators/class_decorator_replaces_method: dynamic/context: the wrapper of a replaced method calls itself through the merged attribute
decorators/registry_decorator: flow/container-update: functions in a dict by key: the dispatcher reaches every entry
decorators/singledispatch: outside/library-callables: functools.singledispatch dispatches by type through its wrapper
descriptors/cached_property: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: functools.cached_property calls the function it wraps
descriptors/non_data_descriptor_shadowed: dynamic/dynamic: the first __get__ writes the value into the instance's __dict__, which hides the descriptor from the second read; both reads call __get__
descriptors/object_setattr_runs_set: language/special-methods: object.__setattr__ with a literal name does not run the class's data descriptor
dicts/assign: flow/container-update: a key assigned again keeps the old function
dicts/equal_keys_overwrite: flow/container-update: keys 1 and True are one key
dicts/merge_operator: outside/builtin-models: the `|` of two dicts gives no dict
dicts/nested: flow/container-update: a nested key assigned again keeps the old function
dicts/setdefault_existing: flow/container-update: setdefault on an existing key also stores the default
dicts/unpack_merge: flow/container-update: a later `**` entry does not replace an earlier one
dicts/update: flow/container-update: update does not replace the entry
dynamic/compile_exec: dynamic/dynamic: exec of a compiled string is not analysed
dynamic/eval: dynamic/dynamic: eval of a string is not analysed
dynamic/eval_constructed_string: dynamic/dynamic: eval of a string built at run time is not analysed
dynamic/exec_defines_function: dynamic/dynamic: exec of a string is not analysed
dynamic/exec_in_function: dynamic/dynamic: exec of a string is not analysed
dynamic/getattr_concatenated: dynamic/dynamic: getattr with a name built by concatenation
dynamic/globals_lookup: dynamic/dynamic: globals() is not the module's namespace
dynamic/import_module: dynamic/dynamic: importlib.import_module does not import its module
dynamic/instance_dict_write: dynamic/dynamic: a write to `obj.__dict__[name]` is not a store
dynamic/locals_lookup: dynamic/dynamic: locals() is not the function's namespace
dynamic/monkey_patch_method: flow/rebinding: a method replaced before the call keeps the original
dynamic/monkey_patch_module_function: flow/rebinding: a module function replaced before the call keeps the original
dynamic/operator_attrgetter: outside/library-callables: operator.attrgetter objects are not modelled
dynamic/operator_itemgetter: outside/library-callables: operator.itemgetter objects are not modelled
dynamic/operator_methodcaller: outside/library-callables: operator.methodcaller objects are not modelled
dynamic/sys_modules_lookup: dynamic/dynamic: sys.modules is not the table of modules
dynamic/vars_lookup: dynamic/dynamic: vars() of an instance is what the stubs say, not its namespace
exceptions/assert_message_not_evaluated: flow/dead-code: the message of an assert that holds is evaluated
exceptions/except_star: flow/exceptions: except* clauses are not matched by class
exceptions/exception_carries_callback: flow/exceptions: a handler catches every instance of its class, raised or not
exceptions/handler_by_class: flow/exceptions: every handler runs, not the first that matches the class
exceptions/handler_calls_exception_method: flow/exceptions: a handler catches every instance of its class and subclasses, raised or not
exceptions/try_except_else_finally: flow/dead-code: except and else blocks that do not run count
external/attribute: outside/unnamed-call-results: the method of the instance that `Cls()` returns has no name
external/attribute_assigned: outside/unnamed-call-results: the method of the instance that `Cls()` returns, passed on, has no name
external/chained_attributes: outside/unnamed-call-results: an attribute of what `ext.client()` returns has no name
external/decorator: outside/stub-callbacks: an outside decorator may return what it decorates; the stub never does
external/exception_caught: flow/exceptions: the stub never raises; its handler counts
external/returned_through_function: outside/unnamed-call-results: a method of what `ext.connect()` returns, through a function, has no name
external/stored_in_attribute: outside/unnamed-call-results: a method of the instance that `ext.Client()` returns, stored in an attribute, has no name
external/stored_in_container: outside/unnamed-call-results: a method of what `ext.connect()` returns, stored in a dict, has no name
functions/defined_not_called: flow/uncalled: calls in a function that is never called count
functions/redefined: flow/uncalled: the first of two functions with one name is never called; its calls count
generators/infinite_break: flow/dead-code: a loop that breaks after the first item reaches every yielded value
generators/unpacking: flow/container-update: unpacking a generator gives each name every yielded value
imports/import_error_fallback: flow/dead-code: an import that fails counts
imports/module_attribute_assigned: flow/rebinding: a module attribute replaced before the call keeps the original
imports/package_attribute_shadows_submodule: flow/dead-code: a submodule that a package attribute of the same name shadows is analysed
kwargs/forwarded_kwargs: flow/unpacked-arguments: an unpacked dict may omit the parameter, so its default counts
lambdas/in_dict: flow/uncalled: calls in a lambda that is never called count
lambdas/same_line_numbering: flow/uncalled: calls in a lambda that is never called count
lists/copy: flow/container-update: a copy of a list sees a later change of the original
lists/del_element: flow/container-update: `del xs[0]` does not shift the elements
lists/extend: flow/container-update: extend adds at unknown positions
lists/insert: flow/container-update: insert does not shift the elements
lists/pop: flow/container-update: pop() returns any element
lists/repetition: flow/container-update: `*` repetition does not repeat positions
lists/reverse: flow/container-update: reverse does not reorder the elements
lists/slice_assignment: flow/container-update: a slice assignment does not replace elements
lists/sort_key: flow/container-update: sort does not reorder the elements
lists/starred_display: flow/container-update: a starred element of a display does not keep positions
match/guard_call: flow/value-choice: a guard that calls a function decides the case: every case is kept
match/literal_pattern: flow/value-choice: a match that picks one case keeps every case
match/mapping_custom: flow/uncalled: __iter__ is never called, but its body is analysed
match/or_pattern: flow/container-update: a pair cannot match the first alternative, but the length of a container does not decide a pattern
match/sequence_custom: dynamic/context: the item that __getitem__ returns depends on its argument
match/sequence_pattern: flow/container-update: the list that a star pattern binds has no known length: a negative index reads every element
match/string_not_sequence: flow/value-choice: a match that picks one case keeps every case
metaclasses/instancecheck: language/metaclasses: isinstance does not call the metaclass's __instancecheck__: without CPython's exact-type shortcut, which needs the whole set of the first argument, the call would add a false edge
metaclasses/metaclass_call: dynamic/context: a metaclass's __call__ is not modelled: the result of one that creates the instance through type.__call__ would be every class that reaches it
metaclasses/metaclass_registry: dynamic/context: the name and the class that each class statement passes to the metaclass's __init__ merge over the statements, so registry['Alpha'] also gets the other classes
metaclasses/type_three_args: language/metaclasses: type(name, bases, namespace) does not create a class
new_syntax/copy_replace: language/new-syntax: copy.replace does not call __replace__
new_syntax/int_ignores_trunc: language/new-syntax: math.trunc does not call __trunc__
new_syntax/json_array_hook: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: json.loads calls its array_hook
new_syntax/partial_placeholder: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: calling a functools.partial calls its function
new_syntax/pow_three_args_rpow: language/new-syntax: pow with three arguments does not call __rpow__
operators/contains_operator: flow/uncalled: calls in __iter__, which `in` never calls as __contains__ answers, count
operators/copy_protocol: outside/library-calls-back: copy.copy and copy.deepcopy do not call __copy__ and __deepcopy__
operators/operator_module: outside/library-calls-back: functions of the operator module do not call the special methods of their arguments
operators/reflected_subclass_first: language/special-methods: a reflected method of a subclass does not take priority
operators/short_circuit_bool: flow/value-choice: `and` skips its right operand where __bool__ returns false, which the analysis does not evaluate
returns/multiple_returns: flow/dead-code: a return that does not run counts
sets/difference: outside/builtin-models: the `-` of two sets gives no set
sets/discard: flow/container-update: discard does not remove the element
stdlib/argparse_action: outside/library-calls-back: argparse does not call the action's __call__
stdlib/cmp_to_key: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: the key that functools.cmp_to_key makes calls the function
stdlib/exit_stack_callback: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: ExitStack.callback registers a function that the stack calls
stdlib/heapq_bisect_key: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: heapq and bisect call their key functions
stdlib/html_parser_subclass: outside/library-calls-back: HTMLParser.feed does not call handle_starttag
stdlib/json_default_hook: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: json.dumps calls its default hook
stdlib/json_encoder_subclass: outside/library-calls-back: json.dumps does not call the encoder's default
stdlib/json_object_hook: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: json.loads calls its object_hook
stdlib/logging_handler_emit: outside/library-calls-back: library code is not modelled: Logger.warning calls the handler's emit
stdlib/re_sub_function: outside/library-types: the match that re.sub passes to its function has no type
stdlib/sched_callbacks: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: sched calls the actions it schedules
stdlib/thread_subclass_run: outside/library-calls-back: Thread.start does not call the subclass's run
stdlib/thread_target: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: Thread.start calls the target
stdlib/unittest_runner: outside/library-calls-back: a unittest runner does not call setUp and the test methods
stdlib_classes/dataclass_default_factory: outside/library-calls-back: the generated __init__ calls default_factory only when the argument is omitted
stdlib_classes/dataclass_order: outside/library-calls-back: the comparison methods that a dataclass generates are not modelled
stdlib_classes/dataclass_post_init: outside/library-calls-back: the generated __init__ does not call __post_init__
stdlib_classes/enum_auto_generate_value: outside/library-calls-back: enum.auto() does not call _generate_next_value_
stdlib_classes/enum_member_function_values: outside/library-calls-back: enum members are not modelled
stdlib_classes/enum_methods: outside/library-calls-back: enum members are not instances of their class
stdlib_classes/enum_missing: outside/library-calls-back: an enum lookup by value does not call _missing_, and its __init__ is not called
stdlib_classes/partial_on_method: outside/library-calls-back: a function passed to library code is not a call: calling a functools.partial calls its function
stdlib_classes/partialmethod: outside/library-callables: functools.partialmethod is not modelled
stdlib_classes/total_ordering: outside/library-calls-back: the methods that total_ordering generates do not call __eq__
stdlib_classes/userdict_update_calls_setitem: outside/library-calls-back: UserDict.update does not call the subclass's __setitem__
type_hints/annotated_metadata: outside/library-types: typing.get_type_hints and Annotated metadata are not modelled
type_hints/deferred_annotation_evaluated: dynamic/dynamic: annotations are not evaluated
type_hints/generic_alias_instantiation: outside/library-callables: calling Box[int] goes through typing._GenericAlias.__call__
type_hints/string_annotation_evaluated: dynamic/dynamic: typing.get_type_hints does not evaluate string annotations
type_hints/subclass_behind_base_annotation: types/annotation-believed: the parameter annotated with the base also holds the base's instances, though only a subclass is passed
